captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a rear de Dion tube axle assembly, featuring a curved, black main transverse tube structure connected to a central chassis mount. Inside the curved tube housing, two independent silver-colored half-shafts with CV joints run to the outer wheel hubs. Each wheel hub has a grey brake disc and a black central hub with visible golden lug nuts. The central mounting bracket connects to a top rectangular chassis plate, and the half-shafts and wheel hubs are designed to rotate continuously about their respective axes.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a rear de Dion tube axle assembly using CadQuery. The assembly should feature a curved transverse axle tube in black, connected to a central rectangular chassis mounting plate via a bracket. Inside the tube, model two independent silver-colored CV-jointed half-shafts, and at each end of the tube, attach a wheel hub assembly consisting of a grey brake disc and a black hub with golden lug nuts. Define continuous rotational articulations for both the inner half-shafts and the outer wheel hubs.
captions.factory:
1. Define materials for the black frame/tube, silver shafts, grey brake discs, and golden lug nuts.
2. Create a chassis mount base part using a rectangular Box and a Cylinder for the pivot pin.
3. Model the main de Dion tube by creating a curved path (or sweep) or segmented cylinders, adding brackets and end sleeves using Cylinders and Boxes.
4. Build the left and right CV half-shafts using nested Cylinders and Spheres to simulate the CV joints.
5. Construct the wheel hubs by combining a thin Cylinder for the brake disc, a smaller Cylinder for the hub core, and small cylinders positioned in a radial pattern for the lug nuts.
6. Assemble the components with fixed joints connecting the tube to the chassis mount, and continuous rotational joints for the half-shafts and the wheel hubs relative to the main axle tube.
